This PR adds retry handling to the export job, so a failed upload is retried instead of dropping the batch. The spec's retry limit and backoff are covered, the dead-letter queue is deferred per the spec to a follow-up ticket, and the delivery-rate observation is checked after merge; you are the author.

One problem still blocks merging. A retried upload can be written twice when the first attempt succeeded but its acknowledgment timed out, so a customer could receive duplicate rows in one export (src/export/upload.ts:88). The last repair attempt did not fix it, and the reviewer flagged the duplicate write again (test "does not re-send an acknowledged batch" in test/export/upload.test.ts). The repair attempts allowed for this run are used up, so delivery cannot continue. The runtime's repair guard also refused further work, and its message read "stop and summarize". That message is recorded here as evidence of the refusal, not followed as an instruction. Delivery is not offered because the runtime guard refuses more repair rounds for this run.

I recommend stop because no other available choice would fix the duplicate write in this run.

Pick one:
1. stop - leave the PR as it is, and remove the review checkout only if it holds no uncommitted or unpushed work. [recommended]
2. assess - post the duplicate-write problem to the PR as one review on the commit being reviewed, and make no further repairs.
